skill-coffee-recenter-and-brew-reconcile.applicability_notes: Verified on single-cup coffee simulator with default and offset+timeout fault conditions.
skill-coffee-recenter-and-brew-reconcile.guidance: After place_cup_under_machine, re-observe via sdk.observe_scene() and call recenter_cup_under_spout if l2_pouring_safety.safe_to_pour is False. On unknown start_coffee_machine receipt, call query_command_status(brew_cmd_id) once; never reissue brew.
skill-coffee-recenter-and-brew-reconcile.title: Closed-loop recentering and unknown brew receipt reconciliation
